banner.title: Privacy settings
banner.description: We use functions that are necessary for this website. We only use analytics and marketing if you agree. You can change your choice at any time.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Required so the website loads securely and basic functions work. This category cannot be disabled.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Helps us understand which pages and content get used, via Google Analytics. We only enable it with your consent.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Enables Google Ads conversion tracking so we can correctly measure quote requests from ads. We only enable it with your consent.
